  version strings, printing True or False

[R4] Public API:
- Exposed cmd_bump(version, bump_type) - bumps a version string by the specified type
- Exposed cmd_check(version) - validates a version string, returns True/False
- Exposed cmd_compare(v1, v2) - compares two version strings, returns -1/0/1
- createparser, finalize_version, and process continue to operate correctly
- All existing tests (166) pass
"""
